about_the_game: This demo includes the opening levels of Gooey, letting you try out the core movement and puzzle mechanics. Progress is limited compared to the full version, but gives a taste of the physics-driven platforming that defines the full game.
detailed_description: This demo includes the opening levels of Gooey, letting you try out the core movement and puzzle mechanics. Progress is limited compared to the full version, but gives a taste of the physics-driven platforming that defines the full game.
name: Gooey Demo
short_description: A fast, physics-driven platformer inspired by Celeste, Super Meat Boy, and Mario Maker. Grapple, swing, and launch through pipe networks, pulley belts, and electric hazards. Collect the L, A, B letters and reach the beacon! Build and share levels on Steam Workshop.
